column1: # Anno117.exe's Phoenix class registry: every row of every class descriptor, in registry order.
# Dumped from the exe in IDA and named from the corpus and dictionary searches (docs/phx-schema-tables.md section 7); no generator in this repo.
# Tab-separated, kind first. Ids are 0x%08x; an empty name is unknown (every name is crc32-checked).
#   A class version; its prop and legacy rows follow. A class's wire order is its base chain's serialized props first, then its own (Prop::serialized).
#   One descriptor row of the class above.

#   An older version of the class above, found in installed assets: its own serialized props by name crc in wire order, comma-separated; 0 is a bool the class no longer has. Solved by parsing every installed asset to the last byte; where two lists both parse (dropping one of two null asset references), the one that keeps the earlier rows is used.
#   A class the exe no longer has, decoded as its base (no own props); its legacy rows follow.
